cmd:
set -eo pipefail; DRIVE_OUT=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/outputs/phase3/t11_gen3c; mkdir -p "$DRIVE_OUT"; LOG="$DRIVE_OUT/install_log_v2.txt"; exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1; echo "[t11-install-v2] start $(date -u)"; nvidia-smi 2>&1 | head -5; df -h /content /content/drive/MyDrive 2>&1 | head -10; echo '---miniconda---'; if [ ! -d $HOME/miniconda3 ]; then wget -q https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-py310_24.9.2-0-Linux-x86_64.sh -O /tmp/mc.sh && bash /tmp/mc.sh -b -p $HOME/miniconda3; fi; source $HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh; conda --version; echo '---clone GEN3C---'; GEN3C_DIR=/content/GEN3C; if [ ! -d $GEN3C_DIR ]; then git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/nv-tlabs/GEN3C $GEN3C_DIR 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; cd $GEN3C_DIR; echo '---conda env---'; if ! conda env list | grep -q cosmos-predict1; then conda env create --file cosmos-predict1.yaml -y 2>&1 | tail -15; else echo 'env already exists'; fi; echo '---activate (set +u to bypass gcc-activation SYS_SYSROOT unbound)---'; set +u; conda activate cosmos-predict1; set -u; python --version; echo '---pip requirements---'; pip install -r requirements.txt 2>&1 | tail -12; echo '---TE linking + install---'; ln -sf $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/python3.10/site-packages/nvidia/*/include/* $CONDA_PREFIX/include/ 2>/dev/null || true; ln -sf $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/python3.10/site-packages/nvidia/*/include/* $CONDA_PREFIX/include/python3.10 2>/dev/null || true; pip install 'transformer-engine[pytorch]==1.12.0' 2>&1 | tail -5; echo '---apex build (timeout 30 min)---'; rm -rf /tmp/apex; git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/apex /tmp/apex 2>&1 | tail -3; APEX_OK=0; if timeout 1800 bash -c "CUDA_HOME=\$CONDA_PREFIX pip install -v --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --no-build-isolation --config-settings '--build-option=--cpp_ext' --config-settings '--build-option=--cuda_ext' /tmp/apex" 2>&1 | tail -25; then APEX_OK=1; else echo '[t11] APEX C++/CUDA BUILD FAILED, trying pure-Python'; if pip install -v --no-build-isolation /tmp/apex 2>&1 | tail -10; then APEX_OK=2; fi; fi; echo "APEX_OK=$APEX_OK"; echo '---MoGe---'; pip install 'git+https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe.git' 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; echo '---env smoke test---'; CUDA_HOME=$CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONPATH=$GEN3C_DIR python scripts/test_environment.py 2>&1 | tee "$DRIVE_OUT/env_test_v2.txt" | tail -25; SMOKE_RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo "SMOKE_RC=$SMOKE_RC"; echo '---patch download script to skip t5-11b---'; sed -i 's|"google-t5/t5-11b",||g' scripts/download_gen3c_checkpoints.py; grep -A 3 'extra_models' scripts/download_gen3c_checkpoints.py | head -6; echo '---HF login---'; if [ -n "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ]; then python -c "from huggingface_hub import login; import os; login(token=os.environ['HF_TOKEN'])" 2>&1 | tail -3; else echo 'WARN: HF_TOKEN not set in env'; fi; echo '---download checkpoints---'; mkdir -p "$DRIVE_OUT/checkpoints"; CUDA_HOME=$CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONPATH=$GEN3C_DIR python scripts/download_gen3c_checkpoints.py --checkpoint_dir "$DRIVE_OUT/checkpoints" 2>&1 | tail -30 || echo 'CKPT_DOWNLOAD_FAILED'; echo '---checkpoint size---'; du -sh "$DRIVE_OUT/checkpoints"/* 2>&1 | head -10 || true; df -h /content/drive/MyDrive 2>&1 | head -3; echo '---write verdict---'; python -c "
import json, os
checkpoints = '$DRIVE_OUT/checkpoints'
size_gb = round(sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(r,f)) for r,_,fs in os.walk(checkpoints) for f in fs)/1e9, 2) if os.path.exists(checkpoints) else 0
env_test = open('$DRIVE_OUT/env_test_v2.txt').read() if os.path.exists('$DRIVE_OUT/env_test_v2.txt') else ''
v = {
  'apex_ok': int(os.environ.get('APEX_OK','0')),
  'smoke_rc': int(os.environ.get('SMOKE_RC','-1')),
  'smoke_text_contains_success': 'Environment is configured correctly' in env_test or 'SUCCESS' in env_test,
  'checkpoints_dir': checkpoints,
  'checkpoints_size_gb': size_gb,
  'gen3c_dir': '$GEN3C_DIR',
  'env_test_tail': env_test[-3000:],
}
print(json.dumps(v, indent=2))
open('$DRIVE_OUT/install_done_v2.json','w').write(json.dumps(v, indent=2))
" 2>&1 | tail -50; echo "[t11-install-v2] done $(date -u)"; ls -la "$DRIVE_OUT"
